QuestInfo.name: Seeking Treatment
QuestInfo.0: Gen noticed the wound on your arm and wants to give you something.
QuestInfo.1: Use the #bMedicine#k Gen gave you.\r\n\r\n#r#eNote:#n If you lose the quest item, you must forfeit the quest and accept it again.#k
QuestInfo.2: The bitter taste of the medicine stirred up memories of the day you met Gen after awakening from a long nightmare.

1.0: #b(Ugh... This feeling of guilt. Who has time for distractions like that?)#k

yes.0: #b(The boss said he'd teach you a useful skill. You can probably find him back at the hideout.)#k

0.msg: Here's some medicine. It tastes like crap, but it gets the job done. Come find me after you've taken it, and I'll teach you a useful skill known only to those of our order.\r\n
